passive_diagnostics.boundary_limit: Socket write/drain and host diagnostic ACK are NOT native client control application, rasterization or paint ACK
passive_diagnostics.window: Read-only owned HWND/PID/client and window rectangles, z-order indices, DWM visibility/cloak state, extended style flags and available layered-window alpha/color-key facts. New diagnostics do not activate, reposition, recolor or change opacity of any window; existing protected capture safeguards are reused
passive_diagnostics.native_prerequisites_limit: Actual writer attachment and native Win32 facts remain unexercised until the authorized control; static/pure preparation is not a native compatibility result

unchanged_isolation.controls: Reuse existing pinned-candidate/source gate, secret scrubbing, task-local temp/appdata, child-local verified FLET_VIEW_PATH, exact temporary non-listening Flet bind exception, loopback-only services and owned-child cleanup.
